claims.text: The PMO media release dated 28 January 2025 states that King Tupou VI, on the recommendations of Prime Minister Hon. Dr. 'Aisake Valu Eke, appointed the new Ministers of Government 'with effect from today, Tuesday 28th January 2025'. Its numbered list has eleven members: 1, Eke (Prime Minister; Finance; Fisheries; Prisons); 2, Hon. Dr. Taniela Likuohihifo Fusimalohi (Deputy Prime Minister; Infrastructure; MEIDECC); 3, His Royal Highness the Crown Prince Tupouto'a 'Ulukalala (Foreign Affairs; His Majesty's Armed Forces); items 4-11 name the other ministers.
claims.locator: PDF p.1, first paragraph and items 1-3; items 4-11 on pp.1-2
claims.uncertainty: The stated effective date of the ministerial appointments. Item 1 lists the premiership among Eke's portfolios; that is not a second start date for the premiership, which the 22 January release dates. Items 4-11 are not imported.

claims.text: The same release states that the Prime Minister 'will present' the letters of appointment to all Cabinet Ministers on Thursday 30 January 2025.
claims.uncertainty: A forecast made on 28 January; no retrieved record confirms that the letters were presented on 30 January.

scope_note: Two-page PDF release (created 28 January 2025, 14:29 +13:00) attached to the live PMO post; the page text matches the PDF. A second upload with the suffix '-1.pdf' is byte-identical. The post's group photograph and an attached image of a different (24 January) release were not used. Items 4-11 of the list are not imported.
